explanation: OEIS A001818, Sun's Conjecture 2 (proved by Yang–Zhang 2026): for an odd prime p, the permanent of [f(j,k)]_{j,k=1..p−1} with f(j,k) = (j+k)/(j−k) for j ≠ k and 1 on the diagonal is ≡ ((p−2)!!)² = a((p−1)/2) (mod p²). The formal statement computes the permanent in ZMod (p²), where j − k (|j − k| < p, nonzero) is invertible, so the division is meaningful, and compares with a((p−1)/2). Faithful.
